name: thing_health
summary: The damage state of any thing (panel, pipe, cable, wall, frame, door, vent, device, item), which no logic type exposes. One thing, up to 256, a network's pieces, or a world scan of damaged and broken things. Read only.

help.text: Four forms. reference_id: one thing. reference_ids: up to 256, a result each with its own error. network_id: every piece of one pipe (default), cable or chute network, worst first, paged (damaged_only narrows it). None of them: scan the world for damaged and broken things, broken first then worst first, paged (8 per page).

reply.text: reference_id, prefab_name, display_name, kind, type, damage_state (destructible, indestructible or none), max_damage, total_damage (brute, burn, oxygen, hydration, starvation, toxic, radiation and decay, clamped to max_damage; stun is not counted), damage_ratio (0 like new, 1 destroyed), health_percent (as the solar panel tooltip shows), damage per type, is_broken, broken_build_state, condition, custom_name, networks [{kind, id}], being_destroyed, band (solar panels: green, yellow over 0.25, red over 0.75), pipe_burst (none, pressure, liquid or solid), position and distance_m.

broken.summary: is_broken and condition, and why health reads 100 %.
broken.text: is_broken: at maximum damage, a structure in its broken build state, a burst pipe (bursting leaves its damage at 0), or a burnt cable (the separate undamaged piece an overload leaves, such as StructureCableStraightBurnt, carrying no power). condition: broken, damaged, intact, indestructible or none; broken wins, because the game heals a structure it breaks to 0 damage. The numbers stay the game's own; condition and is_broken are the signal. An indestructible thing reports its damage numbers as null, never a fake 0.

scan.summary: What the world scan skips and counts.
scan.text: The scan skips things being destroyed, indestructible things, players, animals and organs, and counts decaying food and hurt plants as damaged items (structures_only for the base alone). It also returns count, total (matches on all pages), structures, broken, scanned, min_damage_ratio, offset, limit, has_more and local_player. A solar panel generates (1 - damage_ratio) of its undamaged output.

reference_ids.description: Up to 256 things, a result each.

network_id.description: Network form: a network or a handle on it; every piece, worst first (see networks).

kind.description: Network form: pipe (default), cable or chute.

damaged_only.description: Network form: only damaged and broken pieces. Default false.

min_damage_ratio.description: Scan: only damage_ratio above this (0.25 yellow, 0.75 red). Default 0.

min_ratio.description: Old name of min_damage_ratio, still read; min_damage_ratio wins.

structures_only.description: Scan: leave items out. Default false.

broken_only.description: Scan: only things in the game's broken state. Default false.

near_player_m.description: Scan: only things within this many metres of the player.

limit.description: Scan and network forms: things per page; default 8.

offset.description: Scan and network forms: things to skip (see paging).

x-paging.order: worst first: broken, then highest damage ratio, then highest total damage, then lowest reference id
